description: Tracks what a bot can bump without touching a template: GitHub Actions (pinned by digest, with the version in a comment), the version of the CI tools, and the appVersion of the charts that package one image as is (backup-utils, searxng, homepage), plus the Helm dependencies of every chart.

Left to hand on purpose: cnpg-cluster, vso-utils and system-upgrade-controller, whose templates and CRDs are written against one version of what they deploy; and the images in values.yaml, which default to appVersion.

Not config:best-practices: its docker:pinDigests would pin appVersion, a bare tag, to a digest and cannot be switched off per dependency. What applies of it is listed here (config:recommended, the digest pinning of actions, config migration).

A Renovate pull request on a chart is completed by .github/workflows/renovate.yaml (Artifact Hub changes, images annotation, README): its commits are ignored below so that Renovate keeps rebasing the branch.

customManagers.description: backup-utils: appVersion is the tag of the backup image, a plain X.Y.Z

searxng: appVersion is the tag of the SearXNG image, a date and the upstream commit (YYYY.M.D-<sha>). Only the date orders versions: the commit is matched but not captured (a pre-release would make every tag unstable, and Renovate then only follows the same date), so two builds of a day are one version. The tags are listed on GHCR, which holds the same ones with the same digests: Docker Hub refuses to list past its first thousand, and SearXNG has a tag per commit
homepage: appVersion is the tag of the Homepage image, vX.Y.Z
ci/scripts: KUBECONFORM_VERSION, written without the v of the release tag

ci.yaml: the helm-docs version handed to the shared lint-helm workflow, written with the v of the release tag. It moves with the one of ci/scripts/helm-docs.sh, which regenerates the READMEs this version checks
ci/scripts/helm-docs.sh: HELM_DOCS_VERSION, written without the v of the release tag

packageRules.description: A bump in a chart releases a new chart version, which ct and the release both require: patch for a patch or a digest, major for a major, minor otherwise. The commit is scoped to the chart
prBodyNotes: A commit from github-actions[bot] follows within a minute: it writes the `artifacthub.io/changes` of the new version, keeps the images annotation in step with `appVersion` and regenerates the README. Review the diff once it is there.

packageRules.description: Actions and CI tool versions are not chart changes: ci(deps)
A major update can break what runs on it: label it and read the release notes first. Never merged without a review, as nothing is
prBodyNotes: Major update: read the release notes for breaking changes before merging.

packageRules.description: SearXNG is a rolling release (a tag per upstream commit, several a day): one pull request a month instead of one a week
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The valkey subchart's default image is listed in searxng's artifacthub.io/images, pinned by digest: it moves with the subchart, by hand
prBodyNotes: - [ ] set the `docker.io/valkey/valkey` image of `artifacthub.io/images` to the one the new subchart defaults to (`image` in its values), digest included
